messages:
Ava: Quick q — who's doing something fun this weekend? I'm torn between a sunrise paddle or finally tackling the IKEA plant shelf. :canoe: :seedling:
Jon: Paddle for sure. Sunrise > flat-pack frustration. Also coffee after. :coffee:
Priya: IKEA wins if you want immediate gratification. You get a shelf at the end of it. :package:
Marcus: Tagging in as 'would rather nap' vote. But I'm down for sunrise paddle if someone will carry my paddle. :zzz:
Ava: Haha Marcus, I'll carry it. Paddle meetup at 6:15am at Pier 3? Low-key walking pace.
Jon: 6:15 works. I'll bring insulated mugs and thermos of hot cocoa/coffee. :hot_beverage:
Priya: If you folks are up that early, can I join for coffee after? I can only do late morning activities. :smile:
Social-Bot: FYI: RSVP button added to #rnd-social for events. Click to add yourself to "Sunrise Paddle" list. :robot_face:
Marcus: Also pinging for carpool options — I can take 2. 
Ava: Perfect. Marcus +2 pls. Bringing extra windbreakers. 
Jon: Should we bring bug spray/sunscreen? Low sun but mosquitoes can be savage by the water. 
Priya: Sunscreen for me please — pale skin forever. :sweat_smile:
Ava: I'll pack sunscreen and a small first-aid kit. Anyone want to bring snacks? 
Jon: I'll bring bagels and jam. 
Marcus: I'll bring granola bars. 
Social-Bot: Reminder: public docks have a $5 parking fee on weekends. Cashless payment info: tiny.redwood.social/parking 
Priya: Thanks! I'll swing by after — might join you folks for brunch at 9:30 instead of the paddle. 
Ava: Cool. Paddle crew: @Jon, @Marcus (plus guests), and me. Brunch optional add-ons welcome. 
Jon: Excited. Also Ava — if furniture assembly becomes too tempting, DM me. I will bring earplugs and playlist. :ear: :notes:
Marcus: See you all Saturday sunrise or brunch. Also can't wait for the bagels. :bagel:
Ava: Yay! I will post exact meetup pin and weather check in #random tomorrow morning. 
Social-Bot: Auto-post: Weather looks 62F at 6am with light breeze. Bring layers. :sun_behind_cloud:
Priya: Perfect. See you Saturday (brunch squad).
